name: CP3 - common pipeline, Round 1 frozen configuration (re-freeze)
frozen: 2026-11-27, re-freeze after operator decision B; supersedes CP2 (tag round1-freeze -> round1-freeze-cp3)
why: Teammate's pos_kf_snr (Nadha Irshad, c2-skin-tone 425fdc1) is better on AiPEX-dev (5.65 Python / 5.59 MATLAB port vs CP2 8.82). Disclosure: the method combination was chosen by the teammate after seeing results on all 88 AiPEX videos (incl. our test split), and CP2 + this method were both evaluated on AiPEX-test before the switch; AiPEX-test is therefore not fully held out for CP3.

input_adapter.video: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker 478 landmarks (Python 3.11, mediapipe 1.2.3), largest face then nearest-centroid target, 1-Euro (1 Hz, beta 0.02) -> 10 anatomical patches shared/patches.json
input_adapter.aipex: 3 pre-cropped ROI videos used as patches, no face detection (README 8.5: only allowed dataset-specific setting)

pixels: skin mask + specular removal + 10/10 % trimmed mean (patch valid if >= 20 px)
signal_chain: src/pipeline/snrFusionHR.m: per region Kalman (kalman_denoise, R_k ~ 1/npix, 4 Hz, native frames) -> linear resample 30 Hz -> POS 1.6 s -> Butterworth band-pass order 3, 0.7-3 Hz, zero phase (no detrend) -> 10 s windows / 1 s step, Hann periodogram nfft 8192, unit in-band power -> linear SNR (+-0.1 Hz peak, +-0.2 Hz harmonic) weights, fused spectrum, HR = argmax; region needs >= 90 % valid frames per window
